Then no read of the rwb-document contract is made and no column of the legal action changes

  Scenario: AC10 A caller without Litigation right is refused before any read (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller holds no Litigation right and reaches the action endpoint
    When the caller requests the action endpoint for legal action "LA-0601"
    Then the answer is status 403 with MSG-P4-002 from this service before any read
    Then no column of legal_action or hearing changes

  Scenario: AC11 The business rules of section 8 hold at the service boundary (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the build of this slice is checked against the rules of section 8
    When the boundary test runs
    Then only legal_action and hearing are written, no event is produced or consumed, no inbox row is written and no Schedule is registered
    Then no table or view of another owner and no ACE table or view is read

  Scenario: AC12 A call without valid authentication is refused with 401 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller presents no valid authentication
    When the caller requests an operation this service provides for legal action "LA-0601"
    Then the answer is status 401 and nothing is read from the rwb-document contract or written
